duration.text: The Project Management at Dalian University of Technology is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4583 USD/per year ￥ 33000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK (No need for English taught programs) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Postgraduate school transcript 5.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 6.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1.Hold a master diploma 2.Be in good health 3.Within the age bracket of 18-45 years old (students under 18 years old only can apply if you have guarantor in China) 4.With a Chinese proficiency level of HSK 5 or above (HSK 7 for Arts students) 5.On passing the exams set by the university in accordance with the program chosen, the applicants can be admitted to do a bachelor's degree program at the university.
